eli: kickstarting a small paid test for our "Inference Cost Toolkit" webinar. Need a lean setup: search + retarget, low budget test to validate messaging. can ops draft a microbudget plan?
sara: let's try $300/day for first 3 days then review. split 60/40 search/retarget. retarget creative should be shorter copy focused on cost savings.
mike: keywords: +inference +cost +optimization; phrase "reduce inference costs". retarget window 14d, exclude converters 7d. frequency cap 2/day.
ads-bot: Campaign generated (micro-test): id=camp_33445 status=paused owner=@eli -- conversion_action missing.
nina: routing: SFDC queue webinar-micro, tag via utm_medium=cpc&utm_source=google. Map conversion to webinar_reg_submit.
eli: benchmarks: CTR >=2%, CPC <$2.50, CVR >=1% initial, CPA <$70. if CPA>80 after 48h kill or pivot.
sara: creatives: headlines: "Lower LLM Token Costs", "Optimize Inference Spend", descriptions keep under 90 chars. need 1 static hero + 1 gif.
mike: naming: REDW_MICRO_2026_MAR_search_t1 / _rt_t1.
eli: ops snippet:
